Own network device AAA: TACACS+ and RADIUS services, role-based access and command authorisation, integration with privileged access management and identity platforms, and NAC platform lifecycle where the platform is shared. Engineer the network management plane: out-of-band access, NTP, syslog, SNMP and streaming telemetry collection, configuration backup and secure management connectivity. Design and run the network observability stack (monitoring, streaming telemetry, flow analytics, synthetic testing and packet capture / brokering) across data centre, WAN, campus, cloud and AWS Outposts, providing the dashboards and alerting Network Operations uses. Build and run the network automation platform: a network source of truth (e.g., NetBox or equivalent), Ansible / Ansible Automation Platform, Git repositories and CI/CD pipelines with pre-change validation and testing. Deliver configuration compliance and drift detection against gold-standard baselines, and automate evidence for audit and regulatory reporting. Set engineering standards for network code (repository structure, peer review, testing and secrets handling) and coach engineers across the pillar to contribute safely. Evaluate and integrate tooling vendors, manage platform capacity and lifecycle, and act as the senior escalation point for DNS, DHCP, AAA and tooling incidents. Hand services and platform changes over to Network Operations against agreed acceptance criteria, and build the handover checklist (monitoring, runbooks, as-built data) into the shared pipeline for all four roles. Deep hands-on experience with DNS, DHCP and IPAM at enterprise scale (e.g., Infoblox, BlueCat, EfficientIP or BIND) and with TACACS+/RADIUS services (e.g., Cisco ISE). Strong automation skills in Ansible (playbooks, roles, Jinja2), Python, Git and CI/CD, including experience with a network source of truth. Experience designing monitoring and observability for multi-vendor networks (SNMP, gNMI / streaming telemetry, NetFlow / IPFIX, syslog) using commercial and open-source tooling. A product mindset: you treat internal engineers as customers and measure the adoption and reliability of the platforms you run. Nice to have CCNP / CCIE Automation (formerly DevNet), Red Hat Ansible certification or DDI vendor certifications. Experience with pre-change validation and network testing tools (e.g., Batfish, pyATS) and policy-as-code. Experience in financial services, with familiarity with MAS TRM requirements for access control and logging. What success looks like in your first 12 months? DNS, DHCP and AAA services have documented architecture, tested resilience and agreed service levels, with no single points of failure. A network source of truth and automation pipeline are in production and used by all network engineering teams, with configuration drift measured and trending down. Network Operations has observability coverage across DC, WAN, campus, cloud and AWS Outposts, with alert noise reduced and audit evidence generated automatically. A standard handover checklist runs in the pipeline and is used by all network engineering teams, with Operations sign-off recorded automatically Why join us? GIC is an equal opportunity employer As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance.
